comparison.objective: Place a used syringe into a sharps container that is not full; candidate fractures and retrieves four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Container selection and object disposal versus coaxial tool alignment, bimanual impact control and millimetre-scale fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: The title establishes disposal into the non-full container; detailed scoring thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four safe fractures and physical containment of all fragments.
comparison.reason: Available evidence clearly describes selective disposal, not impact-driven finishing of threaded inserts; missing numeric rubric details do not create plausible overlap.
